messages.subject: D-RUG This Thursday!
messages.body_plain:
Hi D-RUGgies!

We will be meeting this Thursday (10/9) from 10-noon virtually and in person in the DataLab classroom (Library 360). This is a group working session so come with your questions for our expeRts, or just bring your laptop and get in some distraction free R-coding time. Additionally, if there are topics you would like to see someone do a deeper dive on, let us know!

D-RUG: 10am-noon, DataLab Classroom, Library 360, and zoom https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse <https://d-rug.discourse.group> site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators

messages.subject: Troubleshooting in R mini-workshop at D-RUG this week
messages.subject_clean: Troubleshooting in R mini-workshop at D-RUG this week
messages.body_plain:
Hi D-RUGgies!

We will be meeting this Thursday (10/16) from 10-noon virtually and in person in the DataLab classroom (Library 360). This week Elise is running a mini-workshop on troubleshooting strategies in R during the first portion of D-RUG:

Everyone get stuck with their coding in R. Whether it's an error message or just nonsene ouputs, it happens to all of us. The key is learning how to get yourself unstuck. This mini-workshop will cover practical strategies you can take to get yourself out of even the most egregious R binds.

Afterwards we will continue with our open session format!

D-RUG: 10am-noon, DataLab Classroom, Library 360, and zoom https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09

See you theRe,
Your Coo[R]dinators

messages.subject: UC Davis open source symposium this Friday
messages.subject_clean: UC Davis open source symposium this Friday
messages.body_plain:
Hi D-RUGgies!
Datalab is hosting an Open Source Symposium this Friday (10/24). There are four sessions:

- 9am: A panel discussion featuring five UC Davis professors who are open source developers (including Duncan Temple Lang, a member of the R core team who are responsible for developing the R language and interpreter.)
- 11am: Discovering OS projects
- 12 pm: lunch (catered!) and networking
- 1-4pm: learn to use Git and Github, the main forum for open source collaboration. Taught by Datalab staff.

Please register – it’s the only way to get the catered lunch! https://events.library.ucdavis.edu/event/open-source-symposium-2025
-Wes
